title: Lesson 1: OmniStudio Solution & Industry Use Cases
description: Describe the OmniStudio solution as it applies to common customer use case scenarios in different industries (telco, energy, healthcare, public sector, etc.).

questions.question: A telecom client needs a guided, multi-step sales journey that writes to Salesforce and an external order system. Which tool is the primary fit?
questions.explanation: OmniScripts build guided experiences; IPs can be invoked from them for server-side orchestration.

questions.question: An energy utility must display a customer's account summary with drill-down detail on a Lightning page. Which tool?
questions.explanation: FlexCards are contextual UI components that summarize data with states and flyouts.

questions.question: Which statement about OmniStudio is TRUE?
options: It replaces all Apex and LWC development
It is a declarative toolkit whose components compose across industries and channels
It runs only on Experience Cloud
questions.explanation: OmniStudio is declarative, multi-industry, and channel-agnostic.
